name: @gawk/oidc-session
//: Repo-internal, never published (docs/55 D3). No build step: `exports` point at the TypeScript source, which each consuming SPA's Vite and vitest resolve directly. No dependencies of any kind, and no node_modules of its own: the tests resolve vitest and jsdom from the consumer whose vitest run includes them. `./testing` is the fake-IdP harness, for test files only. A change here must bump every consumer's common-ts.lock (docs/55 D10; `go -C tools/commonlock run . update`).
